results.title: NPS To Reach More Investors As PFRDA Allows MFDs To Work As Pension Agents To Onboard Subscribers
results.description: The Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) seeks deeper penetration of the National Pension System (NPS) and will leverage mutual fund distributors’ relationships with their clients and experience of operating the BSE StAR MF platform to speed up NPS Expansion

results.title: PNGRB Clears 1,800-Km LPG Pipeline In Rs 7K Cr Energy Push
results.description: The Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board (PNGRB) has approved three strategically important LPG pipeline projects across Telangana, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Karnataka and Goa.

results.title: JICA helps Ho Chi Minh City upgrade drainage sewer system
results.description: The project will rehabilitate 2.1km ageing pipelines in the city’s downtown, helping improve drainage and sewerage network performance, reduce the risk of road subsidence, and enhance public health and urban resilience.

results.title: Exclusive: Inside The World's Oldest Operational Nuclear Power Station
results.description: Tarapur Atomic Power Station sells power at around Rs 3.31 per unit, making it one of the cheapest sources of electricity available in India.
